goal: Add structured pose and camera data to the existing reference materials and connect it to browser selection, prompt assembly and MCP.
outcome: Implemented and verified locally; GATE: PASS.

model.limits: Each current pose group has one actual view. Metadata describes the intended reference posture/perspective; no calibrated degrees, new view images or depth maps were added.

implementation.sharedModule: constants/poseMetadata.mjs provides vocabulary, validation, labels, search text, filtering and material prompt formatting for browser and Node.
implementation.browser: Materials page and native reference picker share Posture/View filters. Pose details show the group, posture, view, camera height, framing and actual available views. Other roles omit pose metadata.
implementation.prompts: Automatic try-on and basket generation use metadata-derived pose hints. Unknown camera height is omitted from instructions. Manual prompt overrides remain exact.
implementation.mcp: Existing four tools remain compatible. Reference outputs include pose data only on pose materials; search adds groupId/posture/view/cameraHeight/framing filters.
implementation.compatibility: Material IDs, images, basket/draft/history and v1 recipes remain unchanged in identity/format; recipes still share IDs/settings rather than duplicating metadata.

throughputCheckpoint.blockingFirstSteps: Inspected catalog, prompt, selection and MCP boundaries; fixed a five-field metadata contract before delegation.
throughputCheckpoint.independentWorkstreams: One integration owner handled shared model/catalog/prompt changes, with disjoint UI and MCP workers. Root authored independent browser tests.
throughputCheckpoint.sharedMutableState: Shared vocabulary and hint formatter have one owner; browser and MCP consume the same plain ES module without importing Zod into the browser.
throughputCheckpoint.smallestSafeDecomposition: Existing three references were annotated without asset replacement or schema-version migration; an independent read-only reviewer checked the final change.

includes: Posture/view filters and metadata keyword discovery
Pose camera details and accurate unspecified height
Actual provider request contains automatic structured hints
Manual text survives reference changes and history replay
Basket generation preserves ordered pose hints
Real MCP structured filtering and recipe-to-browser flow
Existing draft, recipe, provider, upload, history and viewport behavior
verification.review: Independent read-only review found no actionable new defect.
verification.scope: Provider requests were intercepted and mocked. Live image quality and physical pose accuracy were not evaluated.

deliveryAtVerification: Local working tree only; not committed, pushed or deployed.
